title: Range of the derivative of (t, α) ↦ tγ(α)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, γ : ℝ → ℝ^P, G : ℝ² → ℝ^P (ℝ² = Euclid 2), S ⊆ ℝ² open and t, α ∈ ℝ with (t, α) ∈ S. If G(w) = w₀·γ(w₁) for every w ∈ S, γ is differentiable at α and t ≠ 0, then the range of the Fréchet derivative DG(t, α) equals (as a set) the linear span of γ(α) and γ′(α), where γ′ = deriv γ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (G : Euclid 2 → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid 2)) (t α : ℝ), IsOpen S → !₂[t, α] ∈ S → (∀ w ∈ S, G w = w 0 • γ (w 1)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ γ α → t ≠ 0 → Set.range (fderiv ℝ G !₂[t, α]) = (Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α} : Set (Euclid P))
